## Test Report: `isInCheck(board, player)` Implementation

### Task
Implement `isInCheck(board, player)` — returns true if `player`'s general is under attack.

### Implementation Location
**`src/engine/checkDetection.ts` (lines 113–131)**

### Source Code Verification
The function is fully implemented with correct logic:
1. **Finds the general** via `findGeneralPosition(board, player)` (throws if missing)
2. **Standard check detection** via `isSquareAttackedBy(board, generalPos, opponent(player))` — checks all opponent raw moves targeting the general's square
3. **Flying-general rule** via `flyingGeneralTarget(board)` — detects 将帅照面 (both generals on same column with no intervening pieces)

### Export Chain Verified ✓
- `isInCheck` exported from `src/engine/checkDetection.ts` (line 117)
- Re-exported from `src/engine/index.ts` (line 89)
- Used by: `isCheckmate()` (index.ts:55), `isStalemate()` (index.ts:63), `getLegalMoves()` (specialRules.ts:73)

### TypeScript Compilation ✓
- **Zero type errors in production code** (all TS errors are in test files only — unused variable warnings, `Object possibly undefined` in assertions)
- `isInCheck` and its dependencies in `checkDetection.ts` compile cleanly

### Test Results

#### Engine Tests — ALL PASS ✓
| Test File | Tests | Status |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| `isSquareAttackedBy.test.ts` | 14/14 | ✅ (includes direct `isInCheck` test at line 187) |
| `checkmateDetection.test.ts` | 13/13 | ✅ (depends on `isInCheck` for checkmate/stalemate detection) |
| `flyingGeneral.test.ts` | 14/14 | ✅ (flying-general check via `isInCheck`) |
| `illegalMoveRejection.test.ts` | 17/17 | ✅ (rejects moves that leave own general in check) |
| `debug-shuangche.test.ts` | 1/1 | ✅ (双车错 position: `isInCheck` returns true) |
| `debug-chariot.test.ts` | 5/5 | ✅ |
| `debug-flying.test.ts` | 4/4 | ✅ |
| `fullGame.test.ts` | 1/1 | ✅ |
| `makeMove.test.ts` | 9/9 | ✅ |
| All other engine tests | — | ✅ |

**Total: 98 engine tests — ALL PASSING**

#### Pre-existing Failures (UNRELATED to `isInCheck`)
| Test File | Tests Failed | Root Cause |
|-----------|-------------|------------|
| `GameOverModal.test.tsx` | 5 | Button accessible name mismatch (`"Reset game"` aria-label vs `/play again/i` regex) — **UI component test issue** |
| `useGameState.test.ts` | 1 | `capturedPieces.black` empty after capture — **React hook state tracking issue** |
| `debug-capture.test.ts` | 1 | Same captured pieces issue — **React hook state tracking issue** |

These 7 failures are all in **UI component and React hook tests** related to GameOverModal button naming and captured-pieces state management. They have **no connection** to the `isInCheck` function in `checkDetection.ts`.

- `isInCheck(board, player)` is **correctly implemented** at `src/engine/checkDetection.ts:113-131`

- Pre-existing UI/hook test failures are unrelated to this task
